summary: Accel Atoms is active. Official FAQ says applications are accepted on a rolling basis for Atoms AI and Atoms X; no fixed current deadline is published.

proposed_event.name: Accel Atoms
proposed_event.description: Pre-seed program from Accel for Indian and Indian-origin founders, with capital, mentorship, credits, and global network access.

dates.date_range_text: Applications accepted on a rolling basis; cohorts typically run for about 3 months.

sources.title: Accel Atoms Homepage
sources.supports: Official homepage describes Accel Atoms as a pre-seed scaling program for Indian and Indian-origin founders building from anywhere and links to the application page.

sources.title: Accel Atoms FAQs
sources.supports: FAQ states Accel Atoms is accepting applications for Atoms AI and Atoms X, applications are rolling, cohorts are typically 3 months, founders may be India-based or Indian-origin anywhere, and funding/support/perks are available.

sources.title: Meet the Startups in AI Cohort 2026
sources.supports: Official 2026 cohort post confirms recent AI Cohort 2026 activity, Bengaluru kickoff on March 11, 2026, virtual speaker series in April-May 2026, and June visit to Mountain View.

notes: No exact current application deadline or future cohort start date was published on the official pages reviewed.
The official FAQ gives rolling applications, so date fields are intentionally null except for cadence text.

Location is modeled as hybrid and India/APAC because the program is India-focused, accepts Indian-origin founders globally, and recent cohort activity included Bengaluru plus remote/global components.
